proof_body:
by
  intro R M₂ M₃ N₁ N₂ N₃ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ f₂ g₁ g₂ i₂ i₃ h2 hg hf z ⟨c, hc⟩
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hf c
  have h3 : g₂ (z - i₂ y) = 0 := by
    have := LinearMap.congr_fun h2 y
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply] at this
    rw [map_sub, this, hc, sub_self]
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := (hg _).1 h3
  exact ⟨w, y, by rw [hw]; abel⟩
target_source: ∀ (R M₂ M₃ N₁ N₂ N₃ : Type*) [Ring R] [AddCommGroup M₂] [AddCommGroup M₃] [AddCommGroup N₁] [AddCommGroup N₂] [AddCommGroup N₃] [Module R M₂] [Module R M₃] [Module R N₁] [Module R N₂] [Module R N₃] (f₂ : M₂ →ₗ[R] M₃) (g₁ : N₁ →ₗ[R] N₂) (g₂ : N₂ →ₗ[R] N₃) (i₂ : M₂ →ₗ[R] N₂) (i₃ : M₃ →ₗ[R] N₃), g₂ ∘ₗ i₂ = i₃ ∘ₗ f₂ → Function.Exact g₁ g₂ → Function.Surjective f₂ → ∀ z : N₂, g₂ z ∈ LinearMap.range i₃ → ∃ (w : N₁) (y : M₂), z = g₁ w + i₂ y
